extDescription.message: Keep the page you are reading, a passage or a link in the Penumbra running on this computer.

errorNotPaired.message: This browser is not connected to Penumbra yet.

errorUnpaired.message: Penumbra no longer accepts this browser. Press Connect browser in its settings again.

errorServer.message: Penumbra is not answering. Is it running?

errorRestricted.message: This page cannot be read by extensions.

pairHow.message: In Penumbra, open Settings and press Connect browser. A page opens in this browser and pairs it.

useHow.message: Right-click a page, a selection or a link and choose Penumbra, press the toolbar button to keep the whole page, or use the shortcut.

offlineTitle.message: Penumbra is not running. Captures wait here until it is.

errorTooLargeToKeep.message: Too large to keep while Penumbra is closed. Open Penumbra and try again.

errorQueueFull.message: 50 captures are already waiting. Open Penumbra to send them.

pairHowShort.message: Press Connect browser in Penumbra's settings.

ownPage.message: This is one of Penumbra's own pages

notFiledCap.message: That orbit already holds as much text as one question can read ($VALUE$ characters), so it stayed in the Horizon. PN_MAX_CORPUS_CHARS in the configuration file raises the limit.

keptOffline.message: Penumbra is not running, so it is kept here

keptOfflineNote.message: It will be sent when Penumbra opens ($VALUE$ waiting).

notFiledGone.message: That orbit is no longer there; it stayed in the Horizon.

fileWhenRead.message: It goes into “$VALUE$” once it has been read.

stillSaving.message: This page is already on its way.

alreadyKeptNote.message: This page is in the Horizon already, nearly word for word.

autoFilingNote.message: Filing is automatic: after its summary it goes into the orbit that fits, or a new one once a second capture shares its subject.

autoWontMove.message: Automatic filing will not move it.

cancelling.message: Cancelling: it will be taken back as soon as it lands.

notMine.message: Kept earlier, not by this press

notMineNote.message: This page was already in Penumbra before, so pressing again cannot take it back. Remove it in Penumbra if you want it gone.

tooLateNote.message: It was kept more than ten minutes ago, which is too long to take back from here. Remove it in Penumbra instead.

titleSaving.message: Keeping this page… press again to cancel

titleSaved.message: Kept. Press again to take it back

titleFailed.message: Could not keep this page. Press to try again
